section.heading: ## Lists (proteinjs ui) — a table can draw a head over each group of its rows
section.text: - A table can group its rows the way a list does: one head before each run of rows that share a key, on the phone and on the desktop, while every row looks and works exactly as before. A table with no groups is unchanged.
smoke: - Nothing to try on its own: it is what lets a space's chats list and thoughts list sit under day headings, which ride a later space change with their own smoke line.
